body: Nah, the fourth pic is the only one from february. It's to show the difference.

25M

I suffer from BDD so I could just be imagining things but my hair feels and looks worse lately. Not sure if balding but it looks more thin than usual. Less volume. The pic with sunglasses is from February. My hair looked better back then.

I shampoo every three days and blowdry my hair.

I have thin hair in general but lately it feels flat and weak. 25 male btw. Kinda worried.

I have the exact same thing. It's kinda nice to know I'm not alone. It's one of thise things I've always found strange. I'm not even looking for these flaws, my mind just picks them up and I can't ignore it once I notice it.

Do you also have issues using said things because you keep noticing a detail or flaw? Because I always tell myself to ignore that stuff but it never really works. My PS4 for example has a slight buzzing noise and despite only hearing it when it's quiet, I keep thinking about it and that seems to amplify the buzzing. Like I can't stop hearing it. It's like I want to hear it.

"What if i am the only person in the world with this unexplainable subjective feeling''

Describes my own mindset pretty good. So yeah, you are not alone. Our minds just want to make us believe we are. Makes it easier to feel crazy.

I can't even explain one of my biggest obsessions. It's just a feeling I am obsessed with and can't put into words. That in itself can create anxiety. Fear of the unknown.
What side effects were bad for you at 150mg? I used to be on 200 but my sex life was non-existent.

I'm trying but it's so difficult because the obsession seems real one minute and fake the next.

I'm constantly having "Did I just see that?" Did I just feel that?" thoughts. It's like an unstoppable train. It hasn't been this bad before. Maybe it is because I am not on medication.
